messages:
maria: Good morning — async check-in. What I did: landed kernel slot allocator fix, added slot-occupancy metrics and a small microbatcher guard.
john: +1 saw the allocator change, left one comment about the empty-slot edge case in PR.
maria: thx, pushed a tiny follow-up patch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412
li: ran a quick microbatch perf on canary (gpu-a). Short results below:
```
seq=512 p50=6.8ms p95=28ms tokens/s=14500
after allocator fix p95=24ms (-14%)
```
arjun: nice improvement. i'm still reproducing KV thrash on long-sequence tests (>2048). Looks like eviction loop heats up when cache churn > 70%.
sofia: can you paste the exact command you used?
arjun: `./bench --model opt-13b --seq=2048 --threads=8 --kv-reuse=0`
ben: fwiw try `--kv-prefetch=1` — we saw lower p95 variance on a canary run last week.
maria: opened an issue to track the eviction loop: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/289
deploy-bot: :rocket: canary deploy started: runtime/canary@sha256:abc123 — target: 10 hosts — initiated by maria
john: quick ask — can someone review the allocator follow-up? it's tiny but affects scheduling, cc @li @ben
li: i'll take a look after standup, aim to approve/merge this afternoon.
maria: current blockers: arjun's KV thrash + flaky bench harness that sometimes skews p95. need a minimal repro or script.
arjun: i'll produce a minimal repro gist by EOD, suspect timing around slot reclaim.
sofia: queued a cross-GPU microbatch smoke job on infra to run overnight across 3 instance types — will post results tomorrow.
maria: today's plan: 1) merge allocator follow-up if reviews clean 2) pair with arjun on eviction repro 3) monitor canary telemetry (p95/p99 token latency).
ben: i've pinged on PR review and will flag any regressions if seen in the canary.
maria: thanks all — drop logs here and i'll triage. :thumbsup:
